 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Chandra Prakash

 Oral Order
2 03-11-2025 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, the learned counsel for the complainant and the learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in a case in connection with Complaint Case No. 1450 of 2023, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 379, 504 and 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

However,
cognizance has been taken on 22.05.2024 under Sections 323, 504, 494 and 498A of the IPC.

3. As per the prosecution case, the complainant got Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.74772 of 2025(2) dt.03-11-2025 married with the petitioner on 09.05.2023 in a Temple and subsequently they got married again before the Notary Public, Patna City on the same day.
It is further alleged that while the complainant was residing at her parental house, she came to know that her husband (petitioner) again got married with one Arti Kumari @ Anjali Sinha.

On 16.07.2023, when the Aman Srivastav @ Aman Srivastava @ Ravi ... vs The State Of Bihar on 3 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185040739/
1 complainant came to her matrimonial house, the co-accused persons misbehaved with her and later demanded Rs. 2 lakh from her.

entities.text: Aman Srivastav @ Aman Srivastava @ Ravi ... vs The State Of Bihar on 3 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: She was also assaulted and ousted from her matrimonial house by her husband and other co-accused persons.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
The petitioner neither demanded any dowry nor tortured the complainant.
It is further submitted that the complainant was already married with one Raj Kumar Chaudhary in the year 2016, and out of this wedlock, she also gave birth to a son namely, Ridansh Raj.

It is further submitted that all the papers showing claim of the so-called marriage of the petitioner with the complainant are forged and fabricated and the petitioner never got married with the complainant.

The petitioner has relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.74772 of 2025(2) dt.03-11-2025 of "Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar, reported in 2006(3) PLJR 182."

entities.text: Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar, reported in 2006(3) PLJR 182
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel has further submitted that Section 498 A of the the Indian Penal Code is triable by the Magistrate.

Learned counsel has further relied on the judgements in the case of Satendra Kumar Antil Vs.
Central Bureau of Investigation and Another (2022) 10 SCR 351 and Md. Asfak Alam Vs. The State of Jharkhand & Another passed in Criminal Appeal No (s). 2207 of 2023 arising out of Special Leave Petition (CRL.) No. 3433 of 2023.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Md. Asfak Alam Vs. The State of Jharkhand & Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner carries one criminal antecedent in Complaint Case No. 914 of 2023 lodged by the same complainant in which he is on bail.
5. Learned counsel for the complainant as well as learned APP for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail petition of the petitioner.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances as well as the nature of allegation against the petitioner, let the petitioner named-above, in the event of his arrest / surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.74772 of 2025(2) dt.03-11-2025 learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Patna City, Patna, in connection with Complaint Case No. 1450 of 2023, subject to conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of the BNSS.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Patna City, Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 7. If so advised, either of the parties will be at liberty to make an application before the Court below for referring the matter to the District Mediation Centre for the purpose of reconciliation or one time settlement.
8. This application stands allowed.

(Chandra Prakash Singh, J) Shahnawaz/-
